about_the_game:
Welcome to Biztopia!

As the child of a wealthy family, you are stepping into the city. One day, all your family’s wealth will be yours… Your father wants to see your skills and potential, so he avoids giving direct support; your uncle, on the other hand, can’t resist, he supports you and closely monitors your development through mentorship. This journey, which starts with a small delivery, will take you to places you never imagined. Everything starts with you! Are you ready for the challenge?

🤝 Co-op Experience
Join forces with your friends and grow your business! The city will take shape in the hands of you and your team.

🏭 Smart Warehouses & Logistics
Your warehouse is the heart of your trade journey. You start with basic features; speed up deliveries, increase your earnings, and manage your space!

🚚 Trade Levels
Start with local orders and explore the dynamics of trade. Test your strategy at every step and seize opportunities.

🚗 Vehicles & Transportation
Discover the city with different types and colors of vehicles, fuel management, and parking stations. Don’t miss any deliveries and turn the city into your own trading hub!

⛽ Gas Station
Vehicles have different fuel types; it is your responsibility to refuel them when they run out. Plan your strategy according to fuel management!

🏦 Bank & Investment
Experience basic operations with the bank, manage your investments, and grow your capital. Your earnings depend entirely on your strategy!

🎨 Character Store & Customization
Customize your character with basic items and show your own style. Stand out in Biztopia!

🔬 R&D Center
Develop your trade with research options, increase the chances of orders, and reduce risks. Strategic steps will boost your earnings.

🌟 Reputation & Missions
Complete missions, implement your strategy, and earn reputation. High reputation will bring better opportunities and advantages.

💼 Surprise Ventures
E-commerce is just the beginning! New business opportunities, new ventures, and much more await you in the full version.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 580 / AMD HD 7870
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 MB available space
